primary: pooled stratified paired feasible normalized 3D hypervolume difference feedback minus control after four charged proposal slots
heldout_explanation: Each completed arm is rescored after search using the opposite supported feed resolution; this tests parameter sensitivity in the same ideal synthetic model, not external predictive validity.
exclusions: Exclude no planned trials; failed/invalid attempts remain in denominator and count against budgets. Abort and flag analysis rather than silently dropping invalid/missing records.
interpretation: synthetic estimated achieved state only; no measured validation
